dashboard.label: Topology Settings
dashboard.description: Device roles for the Network Overview topology. Patterns map host names to a role; the topology places devices by role

ul.li: Patterns are host names. * matches any text. A device takes the role of the longest pattern that matches it. Adding an existing pattern changes its role.
Roles: core, distribution and access are the rows of the tree, top to bottom. APs (wifi) are always the bottom row and need no entry.
wlc, firewall and server are not in the tree: they sit in a side column to the right.
Devices without a role are placed one row below their highest neighbour by CDP link. Devices not reached from a role device go to the islands block on the far right.
Changes show on Network Overview after its next refresh (1 minute). Only admin and power users can save.
